tip: Tip: press {add} to add a task from anywhere. Press {help} for all shortcuts.
rowAddKeepOpen: Add and keep the box open
syntaxProject: Put it in a project; pick from the list as you type
syntaxNewProject: Start a new project (underscores become spaces)
syntaxDate: Schedule for a date; 25.10 means the next 25 October
tipsHint: Short notes that point at what each control does.
tourHint: A step-by-step guide that moves on as you work.
shortcutsOff: Keyboard shortcuts are off. Turn them on in Settings, Behaviour.
shortcutsQuiet: Shortcuts stay quiet while you type in a field. Turn them off in Settings, Behaviour.
noProjectYet: No project yet: adding the task creates “{name}”
trySyntaxFull: Try: Buy milk tomorrow or 25.10 · {enter} to add
projectHint: #project to file it, or to start a new one
keysHint: {enter} add {shiftEnter} add and keep open {esc} close
